title: The work order's Over Limit badge describes the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with no credit limit and nothing owed.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on Net 30 with a $500.00 credit limit.
  • Have a new invoice for this test, invoice 1, billed to customer B for $600.00 and unpaid, so customer B is over its limit.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order header shows an "Over Limit" badge: customer B owes $600.00 on invoice 1 against its $500.00 limit, although customer A owes nothing.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R11: “The work order's Credit Hold and Over Limit badges describe the Bill To.”
